method: self-financing fractional-share paper accounts; prior-close decision executes at next adjusted open; survivors are not resized; 50bp round-trip cost is split evenly across entry and exit; eligibility belongs to the prior decision gate

diagnostic_data_gate_eligible.method: a transition is eligible only when the prior close had that arm's signal data and the current close valuation is complete

diagnostic_arm_comparisons.method: paired stationary bootstrap for each preregistered arm; common stationary bootstrap and Benjamini-Yekutieli correction across the complete arm family

session_return_attribution.method: multiplicatively linked prior-close-to-open gross return, explicit open trading-cost drag, and post-cost open-to-close return; components are not additive

rolling_policy_horizons.method: policy equity from the next open before that open's costs to the horizon close; every intervening prior-decision gate and current valuation must pass
